items.label: text
items.text: As we have already mentioned,different isotopes can have very different halflives.Someexamplesofdifferenthalf-livesare shownin the tablebelow.

items.label: table
items.text:
| Isotope     | Half-life        | Decay process                    |
|-------------|------------------|----------------------------------|
| uranium-238 | 4.5 billionyears | aparticle emission               |
| radium-226  | 1590years        | aparticle emission,yray emission |
| radon-222   | 3.825days        | aparticle emission               |

items.label: text
items.text: Isotopes with short half-lives are suited to medical use(seepage 241).This is because theactivity of a source will rapidlybecome very small as the isotope decays quickly.

items.label: text
items.text: Isotopesused for dating samplesof organicmaterialneed tohavevery longhalf-lives.Thisisbecause the activitywill becomedifficult to measure accuratelyif it dropsbelowa certain level.InChapter24,we shall see that there are suitable isotopes for these different applications.

items.label: text
items.text: Graphs of activity,inbecquerels,against time can beused tofind the half-life ofan isotope,and thishalf-life information canbeused to make predictions of the activity of the radioisotope at a later time.

items.label: text
items.text: Theactivityofa sample ofa certain isotope isfound tobe200 Bq.

items.label: text
items.text: If the isotope hasa half-life of20minutes,what will the activity of the samplebeafteronehour?

items.label: text
items.text: After20minutes the activity will have halved to 100Bq.

items.label: text
items.text: After40minutes(two half-lives)it willhavehalved again to50 Bq.After 60 minutesitwill have halved again,so the activity will be25Bq.

items.label: text
items.text: What is the level of activity of this sample after three hours?

items.label: text
items.text: Three hours=9x20 minutes-thatis,ninehalf-lifeperiods.Thismeans the activity will have halved nine times.The level of activity (and the amount of theradioisotoperemaining)will be:

items.label: text
items.text: 1 of the original value,and so of the original activity or amount. 29 512
